last_sync.summary: Both commits in this range are CI-only changes to the Unit Tests workflow. The extra cylinder fuel trim build jobs now run on master pushes, manual dispatches, and pull requests that touch trim-related files, instead of on every push and pull request. No firmware behavior, tune layout, flashing procedure, or builder workflow changes, so no wiki page needs an update.

decisions.rationale: Maintainer-only CI change. The Unit Tests workflow gains a changes job that decides whether the extra cylinder fuel trim jobs run, and the two trim jobs now depend on it. This affects only when automated test builds execute; firmware behavior, calibration layout, flashing, and build inputs are unchanged, so no reader-facing documentation needs revision.
evidence: `cylinder-fuel-trim` and `cylinder-fuel-trim-arm` jobs gain `needs: changes` and `if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.run_trim == 'true' }}`
Trigger changed from `on: [push,pull_request]` to push/pull_request/workflow_dispatch; no firmware source paths touched

decisions.rationale: Integration merge of pull request #93. Its only child commit is audited separately and the merge introduces no additional file changes, so there is no separate user-facing effect to document.
evidence: Merge commit parents 8a9878bd5 and eb97f6eb9; changed_paths lists only `.github/workflows/build-unit-tests.yaml`
Merge message: "ci: limit extra fuel trim builds to relevant changes"; no conflict-resolution content in the diff
